title: Enhancing Frequency Forgery Clues for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
research_problem: Overcoming the poor generalization of existing detectors across different models and settings, and their vulnerability to various perturbations.
key_findings: Diffusion-generated images exhibit progressively larger differences from natural real images across low-to-high frequency bands.

The proposed frequency-selective function and Frequency Forgery Clue (F^2C) representation successfully enhance discriminative bands while suppressing less informative ones, improving generalizability to unseen models and robustness to perturbations.
usefulness_reason: Focuses on frequency forgery clues across frequency bands to improve cross-model generalization and perturbation robustness for diffusion detection.
